description.value: Reckless Shipyards is North Vancouver's dedicated eBike specialist shop, stocking premium brands such as Riese & Müller, Stromer, Bianchi, and Urban Arrow alongside certified pre-owned electric bikes. The shop rents both urban eBikes and electric mountain bikes, making it a natural gateway to the legendary North Shore trails including Mount Fromme. A full-service repair department handles everything from walk-in flat repairs to complete tune-ups, supported by a stock of common parts and a bike boxing service.
